test_cases.test_case: Select an Office that has no associated data — chart and cards show 'No Data'

Dashboard page is open
An Office exists in the Office dropdown that has no client/trend data and no amounts
steps: 1. Click the Office dropdown on the Dashboard_Page
2. Select the Office that has no associated data
test_cases.expected_result: Office selection succeeds; Client_Trends_Chart updates to reflect the selected Office; the chart area renders without error and, because there is no data, the chart area shows no plotted points/lines. The summary cards 'Amount Pending / Disbursed' and 'Amount Collected' display the empty_state text 'No Data' visibly. No UI error is shown.

test_cases.test_case: Rapidly switch Office selection back and forth to exercise chart/card update stability
preconditions: User is logged in
Dashboard page is open
There are at least two Offices in the Office dropdown with different data profiles (one with data, one without)
steps: 1. Click the Office dropdown on the Dashboard_Page
2. Select Office A (one with client data)
3. Immediately (within 1 second) select Office B (one without data)
4. Immediately (within 1 second) select Office A again
test_cases.expected_result: Each Office selection action succeeds; the Client_Trends_Chart and Summary_Cards update to reflect the currently selected Office each time without UI errors or stale data being shown. When Office B (no data) is selected, the summary cards display 'No Data' and the chart shows no plotted points; when Office A is selected, the chart and cards display the corresponding data. No crash or persistent incorrect rendering occurs — rapid switching succeeds.

Collection Sheet feature is available for the center
steps: 1. Open the 'Collection Sheet' for the center
2. Add a new Group entry in the Groups repeating-group
3. Within that Group entry, add a Client entry in the Clients repeating-group
4. Remove the Client entry added in step 3
5. Remove the Group entry added in step 2
6. Click the 'Save Collection Sheet' button
test_cases.expected_result: Save action succeeds; the system saves the collection sheet with zero group/client rows and a visible confirmation is shown or the saved sheet displays no group/client rows (succeeds)

test_cases.test_case: Collection Sheet numeric fields with excessive decimal precision
preconditions: User is logged in and on a Center Detail page
Collection Sheet is open for editing
steps: 1. Open the 'Collection Sheet' for the center
2. Add or open a Client row with editable Loan_Repayment_Amount
3. Enter <a value with many decimal places> in Loan_Repayment_Amount
4. (Optional) Enter <a value with many decimal places> in Savings_Deposit_Amount
5. Click the 'Save Collection Sheet' button
6. View the saved collection sheet or the saved record for the client row
test_cases.expected_result: Save either succeeds and the displayed saved numeric values are rounded/truncated to the system's supported decimal precision (succeeds), or the UI blocks submission with a visible inline error stating the allowed precision (is blocked / error shown). The tester must record the visible behavior and the exact displayed rounding or error.

test_cases.test_case: Rapid consecutive state transitions: Activate then immediate Close
preconditions: User is logged in and viewing a Center currently in Pending state
Both 'Activate' and 'Close' actions are visible in the action bar for Pending
steps: 1. On the Center Detail page (Pending), click the 'Activate' button
2. Immediately (without waiting for page reload or state confirmation) click the 'Close' button
test_cases.expected_result: The second action is blocked while the first state transition is in progress; a visible message or inline error indicates the state transition is being processed and 'Close' did not complete (is blocked / error shown). The center's final status becomes Active only if the Activate action completes; no duplicate or conflicting transitions occur (succeeds for the allowed transition, second is blocked)

test_cases.test_case: Create a new user with required fields and matching passwords
preconditions: User logged in as <role>
No existing user with Username <unique username> exists
steps: 1. Navigate to the Users page
2. Click '+ Create User' to open the Create User form
3. Enter <unique username> in the Username field
4. Enter <first name> in the First Name field
5. Enter <last name> in the Last Name field
6. Enter <valid email> in the Email field
7. Select <Office> from the Office dropdown
8. (Optional) Select <staff record> from the Staff dropdown
9. Enter <valid password> in the Password field (meets password policy)
10. Enter the same <valid password> in the Repeat Password field
11. (Optional) Check one or more <role(s)> checkboxes
12. (Optional) Check 'Override Password Expiry Policy' if required
13. (Optional) Check 'Send Password to Email' if required
14. Click 'Create'
test_cases.expected_result: New row appears in the Users table with the entered Username <unique username> and Email <valid email>

test_cases.test_case: Username uniqueness when input contains leading/trailing whitespace
preconditions: An existing user exists with Username = <existing username>
Tester is on the Users page
steps: 1. Click "+ Create User"
2. Enter " <existing username> " (same characters as <existing username> with leading and trailing spaces) into the Username field
3. Enter a valid value into First Name
4. Enter a valid value into Last Name
5. Enter a valid email into Email
6. Enter a valid value into Office
7. Enter a password that meets the password policy into Password
8. Enter the same password into Repeat Password
9. Click Create
test_cases.expected_result: Creation is blocked; the Username field shows an inline error indicating the username already exists (uniqueness check is applied after trimming whitespace or an equivalent duplicate-detection is displayed).

test_cases.test_case: Password/Repeat Password visually identical but different Unicode normalization — matching logic edge
preconditions: No existing user with Username = <new username>
Tester is on the Users page
steps: 1. Click "+ Create User"
2. Enter a unique value into Username
3. Enter a valid value into First Name
4. Enter a valid value into Last Name
5. Enter a valid email into Email
6. Enter a valid value into Office
7. Enter a password composed using Unicode composed characters (NFC) into Password
8. Enter a visually identical password but using Unicode decomposed characters (NFD) into Repeat Password
9. Click Create
test_cases.expected_result: Creation is blocked; Repeat Password displays a validation error indicating the values do not match (tester should observe whether the system normalizes Unicode before comparison).

test_cases.test_case: Very long Role Name entry (200+ characters) on Create Role
preconditions: Tester is on the Roles page
steps: 1. Click "+ Create Role"
2. Enter a string of more than 200 characters into Role Name
3. Optionally enter a value into Description
4. Click Create
test_cases.expected_result: Either the form submits successfully and the Role details page displays the saved Role Name, or creation is blocked with an inline error indicating the Role Name exceeds the allowed length (tester should observe whether the saved/displayed Role Name is truncated or an error is shown).

test_cases.test_case: Rapid re-submission after successful Create User (browser Back then submit duplicate)
preconditions: No existing user with Username = <new username>
Tester is on the Users page
steps: 1. Click "+ Create User"
2. Enter a unique value into Username = <new username>
3. Enter a valid value into First Name
4. Enter a valid value into Last Name
5. Enter a valid email into Email
6. Enter a valid value into Office
7. Enter a password that meets the password policy into Password
8. Enter the same password into Repeat Password
9. Click Create
10. Wait for navigation to the User details page
11. Use the browser Back action
12. On the Create User form shown after Back, click Create again without changing the Username
test_cases.expected_result: Second submission is blocked; no duplicate user is created and the system shows an inline error or the Users table still contains only one record with Username = <new username> (tester should observe that only one record exists and no second row appears).

test_cases.expected_result: Using the browser Back button after logout succeeds as an attempt to access an authenticated page and results in a redirect to the login page; the user remains on the login page and no authenticated content is shown.

test_cases.test_case: Log Out in one tab invalidates session in another tab (cross-tab session clearing)
preconditions: User is authenticated in two separate browser tabs (Tab A and Tab B)

steps: 1. In Tab A click the User Profile Icon
2. In Tab A click the Log Out item in the User Profile Menu
3. Switch to Tab B
4. In Tab B click a link that requires authentication or reload an authenticated page
test_cases.expected_result: Log Out action in Tab A succeeds: subsequent navigation or reload in Tab B is treated as an attempt to access an authenticated page and redirects to the login page (no authenticated content in Tab B is shown), demonstrating the authentication token/session was cleared across tabs.
